name: youtube-connector
description: Self-hosted, read-only MCP connector that gives Claude full access to your YouTube channel (Data, Analytics incl. revenue, Reporting APIs). Runs free on Cloudflare Workers.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: From your Google OAuth **Web application** client ([create one](https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/clients/create)). Redirect URI: `https://youtube-connector.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev/callback`. See the README, step 2.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The client secret of the same Google OAuth client.

ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated Google emails allowed to connect, e.g. `you@gmail.com,partner@gmail.com`. Nobody else can sign in.

ALLOWED_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Optional. Comma-separated channel IDs (`UC…`) whose owner may connect — needed if your channel is a **Brand Account**. Enter `none` if not needed.
